title: Manner of Notice and Consent Verification
text: Consent requests must be provided in clear and plain language. Where automated AI systems process high-risk documents, human oversight (HITL) must be enabled to ensure valid consent and prevent unauthorized extraction.

title: Technical Safeguards & Masked Cloud Transfer
text: Reasonable security safeguards shall include end-to-end cryptographic masking, tokenization, and strict prohibition of unmasked personal data transmission to multi-tenant or third-party cloud AI systems without affirmative authorization.

title: Breach Prevention and Access Control
text: Access to de-masked original personal identifiers must be restricted through strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication, and explicit audit justification.

title: Retention Schedules and Automated Purging
text: A Data Fiduciary must establish automated data retention policies, systematically purge temporary files and cached document embeddings upon expiration, and log cryptographic proofs of deletion.

title: Verifiable Parental Consent for Minors
text: Processing of minor personal data must utilize reliable verification methods such as government-issued ID token verification, OTP verification to registered parent guardian, or digital signatures.

title: Immutable Audit Logging and Record Keeping
text: Every operation involving collection, masking, token de-masking, cloud query routing, or deletion of personal data must generate an immutable, tamper-evident audit record maintained for at least 3 years.
